Our Data Science team partners deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. We're looking for data scientists with a passion for analyzing data, building machine learning and statistical models, and running experiments to drive impact. Our work is broad and varied, influencing how our products work (e.g., understanding user needs, preventing fraud, or optimizing charge flows), how our business works (forecasting key outcomes, managing liquidity, and quantifying risk exposure), how our go-to-market motions operate (designing growth experiments, optimizing marketing investments, refining sales processes, and estimating causal effects), and everything in between. We have a variety of Data Science roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to partner with our Local Payment Methods (LPM) engineering and product teams. You’ll play a key role in understanding, growing, and optimising our LPM business, leveraging data to make strategic business decisions. As Data Scientists at Stripe, it's our mission to ensure that the company strategy, products, and user interactions make smart use of our rich data, using techniques like machine learning, statistical modeling, causal inference, optimization, experimentation, and all forms of analytics.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD, MSc or MA with 2 years, or BS or BA with 3 years of data science or quantitative modeling experience
  • Proficiency in SQL and a computing language such as Python or R
  • Experience in working with cross-functional teams to deliver results
  • Ability to communicate results clearly and a focus on driving impact
  • A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with a high attention to detail
  • Strong business acumen and experience in synthesizing complex analyses into actionable recommendations
  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding


Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in several of the following areas: machine learning, statistics, optimization, product analytics, causal inference, and experimentation
  • Experience deploying models in production and adjusting model thresholds to improve performance
  • Experience designing, running, and analyzing complex experiments or leveraging causal inference designs
  • A builder's mindset with a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom
  • Experience with distributed tools such as Spark, Hadoop, etc.
  • A PhD or MSc in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Quantitative Finance, Sciences, Operations Research)


In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €77,200 - €115,800. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

Title: Data Scientist, Agent
Description:
TL;DR — You own how we measure and improve Lovable's AI agent. You build the eval systems and experiments that tell us whether a change makes the agent better or worse, and you turn agent telemetry into the fixes that raise success rates and cut errors.

At Lovable, data scientists are not isolated model-builders; they sit close to the product, experimenting continuously with how intelligence changes user behavior and product dynamics.

Why Lovable?

Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products, fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we're just getting started.

We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

What We're Looking For


A data scientist who wants to make an AI agent measurably better, not just report on it. You own agent quality metrics and drive them up.
Experience or strong interest in LLM evaluation and observability: building evals, scoring outputs, tracing agent behavior, and catching regressions.
Strong SQL and Python, applied statistics, and experimentation. Comfortable designing A/B tests for agent changes where outcomes are noisy.
You build systems and agents that produce this insight continuously, rather than one-off analyses.
Instinct for what "good" looks like in agent behavior (success, error rates, task completion) and how to measure it when there is no clean answer key.
Entrepreneurial. Thrives in ambiguity, and works closely with the engineers building the agent.


What You'll Do


Define and own the metrics for agent quality: success, completion, error rates, and the behaviors that drive them.
Build the eval systems and experiment framework that decide whether an agent change ships, like an A/B-tested rollout that catches a change increasing errors before it reaches everyone.
Turn agent traces and telemetry into concrete fixes, working directly with the agent engineering team.
Build the tooling and agents that produce these evaluations continuously as the agent evolves.
Set the bar for how we judge agent behavior where there is no answer key to check against.


Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:


Languages: SQL and Python
LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust, OTEL tracing, many LLM providers
Warehouse & events: BigQuery, PubSub
Analytics & product: Hex, Lovable Apps
Experimentation: A/B and growth testing
Cloud: GCP


And always on the lookout for what's next.

How We Hire


Fill in a short form and jump on an intro call with our recruiting team
A call with the hiring manager
A take-home case study
A Most Impressive Project session
Cross-functional interviews with the people you'd work with
A final conversation with leadership


About Your Application

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you passionate about AI? 🤖




At Satori Analytics, we aim to change the world one algorithm at a time by bringing clarity to global brands thought Data & AI. From cloud-based ecosystems for fintech to predictive models for airlines, our cutting-edge solutions cover the entire data lifecycle—from ingestion to AI applications.




As a fast-growing scale-up, our team of 100+ tech specialists—including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and more—delivers innovative analytics solutions across industries like FMCG, retail, manufacturing and FSI. Join us as we lead the data revolution in South-Eastern Europe and beyond!




What Your Day Might Look Like:




Dive into diverse data sources, analyse them, and assess their impact on business outcomes.
Build and optimise Data Science pipelines—balancing performance, business needs, and model complexity.
Design and maintain ML pipelines: from data cleaning and transformation to model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, and deployment.
Research emerging technologies, platforms, and industry best practices to spot opportunities for innovation.
Contribute to the evolution of our Data Analytics platform, especially in Machine Learning and MLOps capabilities.




Your Superpowers 🚀:




Proven Impact: Delivered at least two real-world ML projects in areas like: Recommender systems, Churn prediction & customer lifetime value modeling, Time series forecasting, Optimization (resource allocation, pricing, A/B testing), Customer segmentation & clustering
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field—plus a Master’s in Data Science.
Languages & Tools: Strong Python and SQL skills (R a plus), with hands-on experience in scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, and Jupyter Notebooks.
Visualization & Analysis: Proficient in EDA and feature engineering with tools like seaborn, plotly, and yellowbrick.
ML Expertise: Solid grasp of machine learning algorithms (classification, regression, clustering, Bayesian learning, ensemble models), feature importance, and model explainability.
Deep Learning: Familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.




Bonus Points for:




Experience with Git/GitHub (or GitLab) and collaborative dev workflows.
Exposure to MLOps platforms and tools.
Use of AI-assisted development tools (like GitHub Copilot) to boost productivity and code quality.




Perks on Perks:




Competitive salary and hybrid work model – come hang out in our Athens office or work remotely from anywhere in European economic Area (EU, Switzerland etc.) or UK (up to 6 weeks per year).
Training budget to level up your skills from the top tech partners in the market (Microsoft, AWS, Salesforce, Databricks etc.) – whether it’s certifications or courses, we’ve got you covered.
Private insurance, top-tier tech gear, and the chance to work with a stellar crew.

Ready to create some data magic with us? Hit that apply button and let’s get started.

Title: Credit Risk Modeller (Data Scientist)
Description:
Join our team as a Data Scientist (Risk Modeller)!

Yes, you can! That's our attitude towards our work, ambitions, ideas and relationships. We, at Luminor, believe that anyone has the potential to achieve big things and we encourage everyone to achieve them – professionally and personally.

Whoever you are, and whatever your role is, with Luminor you will get a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to literally build a local banking champion.

You as the Data Scientist (Risk Modeller) will join the Credit Risk Modelling Unit within Risk Analytics Department which is responsible for the overall lifecycle and methodological update covering wide range of Credit Risk Models within internal rating system.

Risk Analytics Department specializes in modelling areas covering Credit Risk models, IFRS9/provisioning models, ESG models as well as various Data Science and advanced analytics solutions. Here You will be able to grow and learn from best professionals in Baltics.

Lead specific pieces of the modelling effort: review data & attributes, assess modelling options, defend model choices with stakeholders
Develop and maintain Credit Risk models for internal ratings based approach (PD, LGD, CCF) with focus on LGD models

Maintain monitoring solution R/Python code base and lead work on periodic monitoring reports
Identify promising data sources and convert data into meaningful credit insights
Communicate detailed technical information in a simple and clear manner to business colleagues



What Makes You a Great Fit:



2+ years of previous experience working in Financial/ Credit Risk area in banking, financial institution (FinTech) or in other institution using internal ratings based approach (scoring)
Knowledge of a variety of modelling techniques such as multivariate regressions and models with categorical response variables
Excellent analytical (including statistical techniques experience), communication, presentation, organizational and problem-solving skills
Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.) as well as strong R/Python coding, and SQL skills
Good understanding of model risk management and governance of models as well as knowledge of Financial/ Credit Risk regulations (Basel, EBA, IFRS9) will be considered as an advantage
Good understanding of end-to-end credit life cycle for retail and wholesale portfolios also would be considered as an advantage
Higher degree in Math, Economics, Finance, Business Management or similar fields
Fluent English is required in spoken and written communication due to working on the Pan-Baltic level



Why You Will Love Working Here:



Flexibility. Flexible working hours, Hybrid work, and the possibility to work from anywhere in the EU, Iceland, Switzerland, and the UK (in total 90 days per year)

Volunteer time off. We care about giving back to society, therefore, you will get additional days off for volunteering purposes

Health benefits. A competitive benefits package in addition to your salary that includes health insurance after the first 3 months pass in all three Baltic states, as well as Health days in case of your absence due to sickness without a doctor's note needed
Wellbeing. Access to tools and resources that help you feel good and be productive at work and in life
Professional growth. Internal and external training programs, LinkedIn learning, workshops, conferences, online training, etc
Special Offer for Luminor products & services. Enjoy special offers & pricing for products and services provided by Luminor

Title: Applied Data Scientist
Description:
Company Overview

team.blue is the market leader in enabling digital success for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) across Europe, catering to over 3 million customers in 25+ languages. Our mission is to make online business success simpler, by providing our customers with all the tools and resources they need to excel online and remain ahead of the curve.

Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Applied Data Scientist who thrives at the intersection of AI, product thinking, and innovation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing Data Science & ML algorithms to solve complex, real-world business problems across the team.blue group. This role requires strong analytical skills, programming, problem solving and data wrangling skills, good communication abilities, and up-to-date knowledge of the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments.

Responsibilities:


Break down multi-domain business problems with a strong focus on return on investment and impact metrics, and think through the appropriate technical methods from POC to production
Develop solutions and extract insight from data using data science and classical machine learning methods and generative AI (GenAI)
Take ownership of developing, implementing, and automating robust data science and ML models and pipelines, including feature generation, modeling, evaluation, retraining and deployment
Translate sophisticated analytical findings and model outcomes into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, demonstrably driving value and improvements in key business metrics
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver innovative Data Science/ML/AI solutions
Conduct research on the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments and apply them to improve our systems
Document processes, code, and findings for future reference and knowledge sharing



Required Skills:


8+ years hands-on industry experience solving data science and machine learning problems to address real-world business problems across multiple verticals
Expert programming skills in Python and SQL and with relevant Data Science & ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, Pandas, PyTorch, etc)
Ability to think through problems from fundamental principles and operate with a high degree of independence and autonomy while bringing clarity to under-specified problems
Deep understanding of statistical and ML algorithms, methodologies and approaches ranging from SVMs to deep learning & LLMs
Ability to own the end to end of the lifecycle of ML/AI projects from conception to containerization
History of hands-on ownership & implementer of projects that have been put in production and made an impact
Experience in applying statistical concepts (e.g. regressions, A/B tests, clustering, probability) to business problems
Strong problem-solving skills with excellent verbal & written communication and the ability to craft analysis into well-written and persuasive content
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams



Nice to have skills


Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related fields.
Deep understanding of current DataOps & MLOps practices, deploying and monitoring models and ETL (extract, transform and load) pipelines
Experience with AI/ML R&D
Experience across startups and enterprise firms
Experience with distributed data tools (e.g. Spark, Dask, Apache Arrow), observability frameworks (OTel)

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
At myPOS, we’re all about helping businesses grow and get paid. We make payments simple, smart, and accessible for everyone, but we’re more than just payment solutions - myPOS is a partner in growth. From free multicurrency accounts to powerful e-commerce tools, we’re here to support business owners of all sizes and everyone out there who dreams of starting their own business.

As we are expanding our team, we’re looking for Data Scientist to help us make a real difference in the Fintech industry. Ready to join us and shape the future of payments? Let’s make it happen!

About the role:

myPOS is building a high-impact Data Science function to power the intelligence layer of one of Europe’s fastest-growing payment and commerce platforms. As a Data Scientist, you will contribute to a focused team working across a rich portfolio of models that drive smarter decisions in Sales, Marketing, Risk, Operations, Product and Technology.

You will move fluidly across problem types: from customer lifetime value and churn modelling to fraud scoring and agentic AI workflows.

What you’ll do:


Build and maintain ML models across the core portfolio: CLTV, churn prediction, propensity to buy, and Next Most Likely Product (NMLP)
Develop fraud detection models including transaction-level classifiers, merchant behaviour anomaly detectors, and new-account risk scorers
Contribute scored model outputs to the Next Best Action (NBA) decisioning layer that selects the optimal action for each merchant across Sales, Marketing, and in-product touchpoints
Support A/B experiments, uplift tests, and multi-armed bandit evaluations to measure the incremental impact of model-driven interventions
Design and implement end-to-end ML pipelines — from data ingestion and feature engineering through to model training, evaluation, and deployment
Monitor deployed models in production: detect performance degradation, data drift, and data quality issues; iterate and document changes proactively
Collaborate with business teams across Sales, Marketing, Risk, Operations, and Product to translate business problems into well-defined data science solutions
Run rigorous experiments and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Contribute to LLM-powered agentic workflows using tool-use patterns (RAG, function calling, memory) and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex
Contribute to team documentation: model cards, methodology write-ups, and internal playbooks that help the team scale its practices


This role is perfect for you if you have:


3–5 years of hands-on applied data science, machine learning or statistical modelling experience in a commercial setting, with models shipped and measured in production.
Strong proficiency in Python for data science: pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, XGBoost / LightGBM, and at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
Solid grounding in supervised and unsupervised learning: classification, regression, clustering, survival analysis, and time-series modelling.
Demonstrable experience building at least one of: CLTV, churn, fraud detection, propensity, or uplift models in a production environment.
Comfort working with large-scale structured and semi-structured data; proficient in SQL and cloud data warehouses - GCP and BigQuery strongly preferred.
Familiarity with ML experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases) and model serving patterns (REST APIs, batch inference pipelines).
Working knowledge of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and at least one agentic AI framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or similar).
Understanding of responsible AI: fairness assessment, model explainability methods (SHAP, LIME), bias detection and mitigation strategies.
Clear communication — able to distil statistical findings into actionable insights for both technical peers and business stakeholders.


Nice to have:


Experience in fintech, payments, banking or e-commerce
Familiarity with workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster)
Exposure to causal inference methods (DiD, IV, PSM)
Experience building or fine-tuning LLMs, RAG pipelines, or tool-use agents
Knowledge of graph-based fraud detection techniques
Exposure to streaming feature engineering (Kafka, Pub-Sub, Spark)


Why you should join myPOS:


Vibrant international team operating in hi-tech environment
Annual salary reviews, promotions and performance bonuses
myPOS Academy for upskilling and training
Unlimited access to courses on LinkedIn Learning
Annual individual training and development budget
Refer a friend bonus as we know that working with friends is fun
Teambuilding, social activities and networks on a multi-national level


What we offer:


Excellent compensation package
25 days annual paid leave (+1 day per year up to 30)
Full “Luxury” package health insurance including dental care and optical glasses
Meal vouchers of 102.26 EUR per month
Fully covered Multisport card
Fully covered public transport pass for Sofia
Free coffee, snacks and drinks at the office


Who we are:

Since 2014 we’ve been all about making payments easier and more accessible for businesses of all shapes and sizes. Whether you’re at the counter, selling online, or on the move, we’ve got businesses covered with smart, accessible and affordable solutions that keep things easy.

Our mission? It’s simple. Help businesses get paid by taking advantage of modern tech and innovative ideas, so payment challenges are a thing of the past.

Pro tip:

Take it easy about meeting every requirement - this job description is just that, a job description! Even if you don’t tick every box, we want you to apply anyway! This is your chance to grow, learn, and build your career with us. We value potential over perfection, and we are all about mutual growth!

Apply by filling in the form below and send your CV in English!

myPOS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified candidates will be considered for employment without discrimination based on age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Your application will be confidentially reviewed in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Personal information will be used solely for the job application and will be stored for a period needed by the application process. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. Good luck!

Title: Full Stack Data Scientist
Description:
Are you a Full Stack Data Scientist driven by turning data into tangible business results? Do you want to help organizations become more productive and competitive?

Vuono Group is now looking for Full Stack Data Scientists to join our growing team of experts in Helsinki. Vuono Group is a consultancy that drives business value with processes and AI. We empower Nordic organisations in both the private and public sectors to bridge the gap between business needs and AI capabilities, enabling smarter decision-making, increased operational efficiency, and accelerated growth.

About The Role

As a Full Stack Data Scientist, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern data solutions and data architectures. You care about data quality, usability and the value it can provide for various business processes. You're experienced with data science and engineering practices, including data observability, implementing MLOps (maybe even LLMOps) workflows and real-time data processing. You understand the intersection of ML/AI systems and data engineering and can build scalable pipelines that support both analytical and operational use cases. Experience with cloud-native data architectures (e.g. Azure, AWS, GCP) is essential.

At Vuono Group, you will get to work in a cross-competence team making our clients' businesses more intelligent with data. In practice, this means building data pipelines, integrating systems together, and utilising ML and AI for insights and operational use cases.

What We’re Looking For


Experience in planning and building production level data solutions that solve real business problems
An analytical mindset and problem-solving skills
Machine learning modeling and/or natural language processing experience
Experience in designing and implementing end-to-end data pipelines that transform raw operational data into business-ready information products
Experience in running and monitoring production workloads
Programming experience in Python and SQL
Willingness and readiness to learn and operate with new technology platforms, tools, whether low code like Celonis or Fabric or pro code like new cloud infrastructure
MSc degree in Machine Learning, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar
Professional-level Finnish and English language proficiency


The Following Is Considered a Plus


Interest in continuously learning and applying new technologies and platforms; generative AI, RAG, AI Agents, among others
Experience with various tech stacks, e.g. AWS Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, DBT, Apache Kafka, Terraform, or similar
Experience in utilising data from business technology platforms, such as ERP, CRM or similar (SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.)
Experience in transforming data for process and content intelligence purposes
Previous consulting experience


You don’t need to tick every box! What matters most is your drive to make a real impact!

What We Offer

We are building the best work environment for data, AI and business process professionals. To get there, we invest in the well-being and work-life balance as well as the professional development of our people. We operate on trust and transparency rather than titles, fostering a high-autonomy, growth-oriented environment where collaboration, impact, and everyone’s unique thoughts and ideas are valued.

In addition to the usual perks, such as work tools of your choice and extensive healthcare benefits, we also offer our employees the opportunity to invest in our rapidly growing company via an employee share program.

Work with Leading Nordic Companies

At Vuono Group, you’ll collaborate with Nordic clients on a range of challenging digital projects. Along the way, you’ll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, architecture, and how solutions are built. Explore some of our client cases here.

Next steps

We’re always on the lookout for new talent, which is why we recruit on a rolling basis. If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, take the next step and submit your application! Once we receive your application, we’ll be in touch.

Our recruitment process typically includes at least two interviews, giving you the chance to meet some of our team members and giving us the opportunity to get to know you better: as a professional, a colleague, and a person. Reference checks are also a standard part of our process. We look forward to hearing from you!

Vuono Group is a process AI company. We create superior business processes through data and AI. Our growing team of kind and ambitious people is on a mission to turn AI into real, measurable business impact. Take the next step, explore our open positions and connect with us to find your next opportunity!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist (m/w/d)

Vollzeit (38,5 Wochenstunden), ab sofort, Wien

 

Du arbeitest gerne mit Daten, willst Zusammenhänge verstehen und schätzt es, wenn deine Arbeit in der Praxis ankommt? Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen. Wir bei Circly entwickeln Forecasting- und Vorschlagssysteme für Unternehmen aus FMCG, Industrie und Handel. Unsere Lösungen helfen dabei, Nachfrage besser vorherzusagen, Bestände sinnvoll zu planen und Ressourcen effizienter einzusetzen. Für unser Team suchen wir eine erfahrene und motivierte Person, die uns dabei unterstützt, Kundendaten in belastbare Analysen, Forecasts und konkrete Ergebnisse zu übersetzen.

 

Über uns:




Circly entwickelt KI-gestützte Systeme für Forecasting und Bedarfsplanung. Wir arbeiten an Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kund:innen eingesetzt werden und dort einen messbaren Unterschied machen. Dabei setzen wir auf moderne Infrastruktur, zeitgemäße Data- und ML-Setups und beschäftigen uns auch mit agentic approaches, wenn sie in Forecasting, Entscheidungslogik und operativen Prozessen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen.

 

Deine Aufgaben:




In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng an den Daten und Fragestellungen unserer Kund:innen. Ein zentraler Teil deiner Arbeit ist es, Daten sauber aufzubereiten, zu analysieren und Ergebnisse so aufzubereiten, dass sie für unsere Kund:innen und unser Produkt nutzbar werden. Die Aufgaben orientieren sich bewusst an der bisherigen Ausschreibung. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

 

·        Analyse und Aufbereitung der Daten unserer Kund:innen

·        Erstellung von Auswertungen und Berichten für unsere Kund:innen

·        Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Forecasting- und ML-Modelle

·        Bearbeitung konkreter datenbezogener Fragestellungen in Kundenprojekten

·        Übernahme kleinerer Arbeitspakete im Development

·        enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Data-Science-, Product- und Founder-Team

 

Dein Profil:




Wir suchen jemanden, der bereits praktische Erfahrung mitbringt, strukturiert arbeitet und Lust hat, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Was uns wichtig ist:




·        mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Informatik oder IT

·        Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von konkreten Datenprojekten

·        gute Kenntnisse in Python und relevanten Data-Science-Libraries wie pandas, numpy, scikit-learn oder vergleichbarem

·        Kenntnisse in Datenvorverarbeitung und Data Engineering

·        analytisches Denken, kritische Herangehensweise und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

·        Teamgeist und Kommunikationsstärke

 

Zusätzlich freuen wir uns über Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen:




·        FMCG, Retail, Supply Chain oder Produktionsumfeld

·        Forecasting, Time Series oder Demand Planning

·        Pipelines, Docker/Container, Git/GitHub

·        moderne ML-Infrastruktur oder agentic approaches




Was wir bieten: Bei uns ist Data Science ein zentraler Teil des Produkts. Du arbeitest an realen Anwendungsfällen, bringst deine Ideen ein und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die bei Kund:innen im Einsatz sind.

 

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

·        ein spannendes Produkt mit direktem Praxisbezug & Arbeit an Use Cases in FMCG, Industrie und Handel

·        Raum für Eigenverantwortung und Ideen in einem Büro im 1. Bezirk in Wien

·        ein motiviertes Team mit direkter Zusammenarbeit für persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung

·        Teamevents, gemeinsames Essen im Park und eine sehr gute Arbeitsatmosphäre




Für diese Position ist eine All-in-Vereinbarung vorgesehen. Das Bruttomonatsgehalt auf Vollzeitbasis beträgt EUR 3.175 bis EUR 4.400, 14-mal jährlich, abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

 

Interesse?




﻿Dann freuen wir uns über eine E-Mail mit ein paar Worten zu deiner Motivation und einem Link zu deinem LinkedIn- oder GitHub-Profil an working@circly.at. Ein formelles Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Title: Full Stack Data Scientist
Description:
Millaisesta työstä sinä innostuisit juuri nyt?




Olisiko työn haastettava ja kehitettävä taitojasi? Tulisiko sen tuottaa tunne, että olet tekemässä jotain merkittävää? Haluaisitko työskennellä työyhteisössä, jossa välittäminen näkyy jokapäiväisissä teoissa ja kohtaamisissa?




Mitä jos sanoisimme, että meillä työskennellessäsi nämä kaikki seikat yhdistyvät yhdeksi – sinun erinomaiseksi työntekijäkokemukseksesi.




🚀 Lyhyt kuvaus työstäsi Full Stack Data Scientistina

Kanssamme luot asiakkaillemme liiketoiminnallista arvoa ja konkreettista kilpailuetua auttamalla heitä tekemään parempia päätöksiä datan avulla.




Konsultoit, kehität ja viet eteenpäin innovaatioita, jotka auttavat yrityksiä ja yhteisöjä toimimaan fiksusti ja ketterästi. Teet monimutkaisesta yksinkertaista uusimmilla teknologioilla, tehokkaimmilla laskentatavoilla ja parhailla käytännöillä.




Teknologisesta näkökulmasta erilaiset tietovarastot, laskentaympäristöt ja datankäsittelytyökalut ovat osa arkeasi siinä missä pilvipalvelut (AWS, ja Azure ja GCP) sekä ohjelmointikielet ovat erottamaton osa työtäsi.




Vielä lisää konkretiaa

Olemme ylpeitä, kuinka jatkuva oppiminen on luonnollinen osa nitorilaisten päivittäistä asiakasprojektissa työskentelyä. Lue Data Scientistimme, Tuukka Stewenin oppimismatkasta.

Täältä pääset tutustumaan Finnairille toteuttamaamme operatiivisen toiminnan työkaluun.

Data Scientistimme ja projektissa mukana ollut tuleva työkaverisi Jukka kertoo kokemuksiansa projektista ja meillä työskentelystä täällä.

Miltä dataosaajamme työpäivä näyttää – käy vilkaisemassa Eeron tarina.




🤝 Dataliiketoimintamme on yksi kasvualueistamme




Meillä on kokemusta ja osaamista merkittävien toimeksiantojen toteuttamiseen. Asiakastyytyväisyytemme on huippuluokkaa ja kehitämme jatkuvasti toimintaamme.




Katseemme on myös vahvasti tulevassa. Kun tulet työkaveriksemme, uskomme, että se vie meitä taas askeleen eteenpäin – samalla kun katsomme sinulle uraasi ja kehittymistäsi tukevat toimeksiannot, joissa työskentelet yhdessä toisten nitorilaisten kanssa. Meillä saat toteuttaa näköistäsi työelämää yhteiseen tulevaisuuteemme vaikuttaen.




Tuleva data-asiantuntijoiden tiimisi on tiivis startup-henkinen ja uuden oppimista arvostava, jolta löytyy poikkeuksellisen korkeatasoista dataosaamista. Ja jos palaset loksahtavat kohdalleen, tätä joukkoa sinä täydennät juuri sellaisena kuin olet.




✅ Mitä sinä voisit tuoda mukanasi?




Tässä tehtävässä loistat, kun sinulla on ohjelmointikokemusta, kyky kehittää koodia modernein menetelmin sekä matemaattisen ajattelun mentaliteetti ja taito. Olet kiinnostunut tekoälystä ja koneoppimisesta. Koska ala menee eteenpäin vauhdilla, on tärkeää, että olet innostunut uuden omaksumisesta ja näet haasteet mahdollisuuksina.




Mitä enemmän sinulla on osaamista, se luonnollisesti tarjoaa enemmän mahdollisuuksia heti ensimetreistäsi lähtien. Emme kuitenkaan halua liian tarkkaan määrittää tässä kohtaa, millainen sinun tulisi olla. Palaset kun voivat loksahtaa kohdalleen niin monella tapaa.




🏆Mitä jos valitsisitkin meidät?

Me uskomme, että rekrytoinnissa ei ole kyse siitä, että yritys valitsee uuden työntekijän. Sinä lopulta teet valinnan. Ja me voimme sinua siinä auttaa.




Sinun kannattaa olla meihin yhteydessä, jos

haluat työskennellä mielekkäiden toimeksiantojen parissa relevantteja, uusia asioita oppien.
rinnallasi työskentelevät osaavat kollegat, erinomaiset kouluttautumismahdollisuudet sekä optimaaliset työolosuhteet ja -välineet ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita.
koet, että yhteisöllisyys ja toisille hyvän tahtominen ovat työelämässä merkityksellisiä arvoja.
sinusta on ihan ok tehdä normityöaikaa ja huolehtia, että vapaat ja työt pysyvät balanssissa.
työskentelet mielelläsi pitkäaikaisissa asiakkuuksissa projektista toiseen poukkoilun sijaan.




Työskentelyäsi ja arkeasi tukevat meillä myös muuten hyvin monimuotoiset edut ja mahdollisuudet:




Voit esimerkiksi käyttää 10 % työajastasi ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Palkitsemme suorittamasi sertifikaatit bonuksin (500–2000 €/sertifikaatti).
Saat käyttöösi 7100 € työvälineiden hankkimiseen.
Sinulla on mahdollisuus palkalliseen lomaan heti meillä aloitettuasi.
Lisäksi meillä on kattavat henkilöstöedut ja innostavaa yhteistä ajanviettoa.




⭐ Haluaisitko jutella kanssamme tarkemmin, mitä me voisimme sinulle tarjota?

Liity nyt data-ammattilaistemme, koodareidemme, suunnittelijoidemme ja valmentajiemme joukkoon työskentelemään luovassa sekä byrokratiavapaassa työkulttuurissa.




Olisimme todella innostuneita kuulemaan sinusta lisää. Kerro, millaista askelta olet urallasi ottamassa, ja katsotaan, miten me voisimme sinua auttaa.




❓Onko mielessäsi kysymyksiä? Pohdituttaako jokin seikka?

Lähetä meille viesti niin People Partnerimme Ella Raskila (ella.raskila@nitor.com) vastaa kaikkiin kysymyksiisi ja auttaa sinua. Varmistetaan, että saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon sinulle tärkeän päätöksen tekemiseksi.




👥 Me kuuntelemme sinua

Me haluamme tarjota työntekijöillemme parhaan mahdollisen työpaikan ja tukea sinun osaamisesi kehittymistä. Nitorilla juuri sinä, ainutlaatuiset taitosi ja henkilökohtaiset kiinnostuksen kohteesi määrittävät urasi suunnan.

Kiehtovat projektit, luontainen uteliaisuutemme ja kollegojesi tuki motivoivat sinua jatkuvassa oppimisessa. Osallistut mielenkiintoisiin koulutuksiin, tapahtumiin ja konferensseihin. Lisäksi voit käyttää osan työajastasi uuden oppimiseen, yhteisömme kehittämiseen sekä sinua inspiroiviin pro bono –projekteihin.

Meillä urapolkusi ei ole ennalta määrätty – päinvastoin, kannustamme sinua tutkimaan kiinnostuksen kohteitasi ilman turhaa hierarkiaa ja byrokratiaa. Nitorilla äänesi kuuluu.




🎯 Lyhyesti Nitorista – toivottavasti sinunkin tulevasta työpaikastasi

Jokainen nitorilainen on pragmaattinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei tyydy oletuksiin. Meille ominaista ovat todella korkea ammattitaito ja ylpeys niin omasta kuin kollegoidemmekin työstä.

Yli 250 asiantuntijaamme toimivat Helsingissä, Tampereella ja Tukholmassa, yhdistäen monipuoliset osaamisensa merkityksellisten vaikutusten saavuttamiseksi. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijälähtöisestä kulttuuristamme ja aidosta sitoutumisestamme ihmistemme kasvuun – tunnustuksena tästä meidät on palkittu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatilla sekä valittu Suomen vetovoimaisimmaksi työnantajabrändiksi.




Visiomme on selkeä: olla alan halutuin työpaikka, jossa menestys syntyy työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnista ja tyytyväisyydestä. Jatkamme kasvuamme IT-alan asiakastyytyväisyyden suunnannäyttäjänä tuottaen erinomaista lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme (lue, miten ainutlaatuinen asiakaskokemus ruokkii kasvuamme).

Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
Als Data Scientist lever je inzichten uit gegevens door het analyseproces te optimaliseren en visuele gegevensrepresentaties te presenteren. Je zoekt, beheert en voegt meerdere gegevensbronnen samen en zorgt voor consistentie van gegevenssets. Je identificeert de wiskundige modellen, selecteert en optimaliseert de algoritmen om bedrijfswaarde te leveren door middel van inzichten. Je stelt patronen vast en beveelt manieren aan om gegevens toe te passen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en dat zit in ons DNA! Met jouw inzicht in cijfers, data en techniek leg je elke complexiteit simpel uit aan de klant. Klanttevredenheid is belangrijk voor je, dus je luistert goed en geeft inzichtelijke antwoorden die de klant het vertrouwen geeft dat het probleem wordt opgelost. Aan de hand van de informatiebehoefte van jouw stakeholders ontwikkel, test en implementeer je data science-modellen en help je collega’s om de mogelijkheden die schuilen in de rijke data bij onze gerenommeerde klanten, optimaal te benutten. Natuurlijk houd je daarbij de ontwikkelingen in het vak goed in de gaten. Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen met data science? Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele sfeer waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan.


Wat kun jij van ons verwachten?

  • Naast een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met andere SIG Data Analytics en Competence Center Data Analyse, Big data en BI;
  • 25 vakantiedagen en snel oplopend tot 28 vakantiedagen per jaar;
  • Het aan- of verkopen van vakantiedagen;
  • Regelmatig sociale uitjes zoals sportdagen, weekendjes weg en gezellige borrels.


Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit

We bieden jou persoonlijke ontwikkeling aan en zo werk je aan jouw carrière. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar is ons DNA. Als Data Scientist kun je doorgroeien naar diverse rollen, zoals Data Science Consultant, Business Analist, Senior Consultant.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde HBO/WO opleiding met een sterk ICT-component;
  • Ervaring met het structureren en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden data om daarin relevante inzichten te ontdekken;
  • Kennis van artificial intelligence, predictive analysis of Deepen/of Machine learning (libraries zoals TensorFlow, Keras, sklearn, Caffe, Torch);
  • Kennis van en ervaring met één of meerdere analytics tools zoals R, Spark, Storm, HIVE, QlikView, Power BI, Splunk, MatLab, of SAS Suite etc.;
  • Kennis van en ervaring met databasetechnologieën (Hadoop, SQL NoSQL, NewSQL etc.);
  • Ervaring met het visualiseren van data met behulp van de laatste state-of-the-art technologieën;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels.


Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS?

  • 15 keer Top Employer!
  • Uitstekend salaris;
  • Vrije keuze leaseauto;
  • € 5000,- opleidingsbudget;
  • Aantrekkelijke bonussen;
  • Veel sociale evenementen;
  • Uitdagende projecten;
  • Gevarieerde opdrachten;
  • Gerenommeerde klanten.


Ben je overtuigd?

We willen graag kennis met je maken. Solliciteer vrijblijvend of neem contact met ons op via:

  • Mail: recruitment@cimsolutions.nl;
  • Telefoon: 0499-366 000;
  • of bezoek onze website: www.cimsolutions.nl/werken-bij/

Title: Lead Data Scientist
Description:
Principal / Lead Data Scientist - AI & Machine Learning Excellence




Drive AI quality, governance, and innovation in a next-generation data environment




This Principal / Lead Data Scientist role places you at the centre of AI transformation, bridging traditional Machine Learning with modern AI systems. You will be responsible for establishing best practices around experimentation, model evaluation, monitoring, and governance to ensure AI solutions deliver consistent, accurate, and responsible outcomes.




As part of a highly skilled AI and Data team, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong analytical thinking and stakeholder collaboration. You will influence how AI models are assessed, improved, and maintained throughout their lifecycle, while contributing hands-on to Machine Learning initiatives.




This is a unique opportunity for an experienced Data Scientist to play a key role in shaping AI standards within an innovative and data-driven organisation.




You Will:




Define and implement best practices for AI and Machine Learning experimentation, ensuring structured, measurable, and reproducible approaches.




Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks, datasets, benchmarks, and metrics for ML and LLM-based systems.




Analyse model behaviour, monitor performance, identify risks, and drive continuous improvements.




Collaborate with technical teams and domain experts to translate complex requirements into structured AI solutions.




Develop and evaluate traditional Machine Learning models, including classification, scoring, and predictive modelling solutions.




Support AI teams by guiding testing methodologies, quality standards, and governance processes.




Establish monitoring and lifecycle management practices to ensure reliable AI performance over time.




Skills / Experience:




7+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or AI-focused roles.




Strong experience developing, evaluating, and improving supervised Machine Learning models.




Advanced knowledge of Python, SQL, and ML evaluation methodologies.




Experience with ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow or similar platforms.




Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Vector Databases, RAG solutions, or AI orchestration frameworks is highly desirable.




Strong analytical and mathematical ability with excellent problem-solving skills.




Ability to establish standards, influence teams, and communicate complex concepts effectively.




Salary / Remuneration:




Up to 80K + Bonus and Benefits




Senior position with significant influence over AI strategy, quality, and governance.




Opportunity to work on advanced AI and Machine Learning initiatives.




Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and complex real-world use cases.




Strong career development opportunities within an innovative environment.




For more information, contact Luca Ottati confidentially at +356 9999 5307 or send your CV to luca.ottati@boston-link.com

Title: Data Scientist / AI Engineer
Description:
Teach the engine to reason, then ship it

At Fluxion, modeling and AI are the same problem.

You'll work on the core engine that evaluates, simulates, and reasons over complex graph-based business models. You'll also build the AI agents that use it to explore assumptions, propose scenarios, and explain what they find.

This is an end-to-end role. You will not hand a notebook to an engineer. You own the path from mathematical idea to production code, in the same codebase as everyone else.

This role sits at the intersection of:


Applied mathematics and statistics
Semantic and causal modeling
LLM-based agents and reasoning systems
Simulation and scenario analysis
Production engineering


We are building infrastructure for reasoning over structured models, and the agents that reason with it.

What You'll Do


Design and implement the mathematical and statistical core of our modeling engine, covering forecasting, uncertainty, sensitivity, and causal propagation
Turn modeling ideas into production code in the product codebase, not into prototypes someone else rewrites
Build AI agents that operate on top of the engine: interpreting intent, constructing and modifying models, and running scenario exploration
Design the interface between deterministic computation and probabilistic reasoning, deciding what the engine must guarantee and what the agent is allowed to infer
Develop evaluation frameworks for agent behaviour, covering correctness, reliability, regression, and failure analysis
Make the output explainable, with traceable assumptions, visible causality, and defensible numbers
Work directly with users' real modeling problems and translate them into engine capabilities


About You


Come from a quantitative background (data science, mathematics, statistics, physics, operations research, or similar) and have since moved into building AI systems
Are a genuinely end-to-end data scientist: you ship, review, test, and maintain code that runs in production
Have strong foundations in probability, statistics, optimisation, and numerical methods, and know when a model is wrong rather than merely unconverged
Have built with LLMs beyond prompting, including tool use, structured output, agent orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation
Think rigorously about correctness and determinism, and are uncomfortable shipping a system whose failure modes you cannot describe
Can reason about the semantics of a problem and not just the metrics, about why a relationship holds and not only that it correlates
Communicate clearly about uncertainty with people who need to make decisions under it


Our relevant tech stack for this role


Python
Polars, NumPy, SciPy
PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy
FastAPI


Additionally, experience with any modeling packages, such as scikit-learn, Prophet, XGBoost etc. and any AI agent orchestration and evaluation frameworks is beneficial and potentially applicable.

Strong plus signals


Background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or a similar quantitative field
Experience with financial modelling, forecasting, optimisation, planning, or simulation systems
Experience designing evaluation harnesses for LLM or agent systems
Experience with causal inference, Bayesian methods, or probabilistic programming
Experience with graph-based representations, constraint systems, or symbolic computation
Have built a product feature end to end, not only analysis or research output
Have shipped work where you both derived the method and wrote the production code behind it
Prefer designing the system underneath the pipeline to tuning the pipeline that already exists
Are at home in problems that are not yet well specified, on a stack that is still changing


About Fluxion

Fluxion is a decision intelligence platform that empowers forward-looking teams to answer their toughest "what-if" questions with confidence. Using AI-native scenario modeling, Fluxion lets organizations explore assumptions and simulate outcomes across financial and operational models in real time — without rebuilding spreadsheets or rigid tools. Its semantic approach to decision modeling keeps assumptions explicit, preserves causality, and delivers traceable, explainable insights so teams make better decisions faster. Designed for high-impact decisions under uncertainty, Fluxion replaces fragile, manual exploration with a dynamic environment where curiosity is cheap, safe, and continuous.

Title: Data Scientist – TV-Insight
Description:
Are you passionate about creating innovative data-driven products that reshape industries?

TV-Insight is an exciting digital spin-off within Red Bull, located in Elsbethen (Austria), dedicated to revolutionizing the TV measurement and advertisement industry. As a Data Scientist, you will be at the forefront of creating and improving the analytical foundation of our novel product, capable of handling multiple millions of classification tasks every second. Working alongside a team of talented data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, you will play a key role in defining the success of a state-of-the-art analytics product.

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

Model Ownership & Production Deployment

You take ownership of the development and deployment of machine learning models for a dedicated TV-Insight market. This includes building and improving real-time machine learning applications as well as developing model components that feed into real-time projection processing. Working closely with a highly specialized team of engineers and data analysts, you ensure a strong understanding of the technical implementation while setting the highest standards for statistical modelling, creating direct business impact from day one.

Exploratory Analysis, Model Understanding & Communication

You conduct thorough exploratory data analyses to evaluate input data and gain a deep understanding of model behaviour and performance. In both research tasks and day-to-day work, you uphold best practices in modelling approaches and production-quality code. You communicate your insights in a clear and accessible way through dashboards and reports, enabling data-driven decision-making for management and key stakeholders.

Continuous Innovation & Technical Excellence

You continuously stay up to date with technological and industry developments to expand your skill set and strengthen your ability to innovate. You critically assess the potential of new methods, tools, and trends, and proactively implement your own ideas in small-scale experiments to test and validate their expected benefits before scaling them into production.

Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:


Master’s degree or PhD in a highly quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
3+ years of professional experience in quantitative analytics, data science, or applied statistics.
Strong hands-on experience in statistical modelling using R or Python, with solid experience working with databases and query languages such as SQL.
Proven expertise in applying core statistical methods, including regression, classification, and hypothesis testing, to real-world business problems.
Ability to translate complex analytical results into clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards using tools such as ggplot, R Shiny, or Data Studio.
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams.


Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to disclose the minimum salary according to the collective agreement for this position, which is € 2.362 gross per month. However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary.

As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

Title: Data Scientist

We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. Consolidated revenues of US $14.5B for 12 months ending December 2025




Position Overview

We are seeking a quality-focused, detail-oriented Data Scientist with a proven ability to deliver data-driven solutions that support critical business objectives and strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate is a strong analytical thinker and problem solver who can translate complex business requirements into actionable data solutions while delivering results in a fast-paced environment.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support business intelligence and reporting needs.

Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions.

Map and validate data elements for ETL processes.

Optimize and maintain data models to support both new initiatives and existing systems.

Generate and support deployment of physical database structures (DDL).

Identify and resolve data integration challenges across multiple systems.

Partner with business and technical stakeholders to define requirements and recommend solutions.

Provide guidance to analysts, developers, and engineers regarding system capabilities, limitations, interfaces, and performance requirements.

Support data-driven decision-making through advanced analytics, statistical modeling, forecasting, and machine learning techniques.

Develop impactful visualizations and reports to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences.




Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field.

Significant experience in Data Analytics, Data Science, or related technical roles.

Hands-on experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin and Visio.

Experience working with large datasets and enterprise analytics platforms.

Strong knowledge of data modeling, ETL processes, and data integration.

Advanced experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, R Shiny, Plotly, or D3.js.

Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.

Expertise in statistics, econometrics, forecasting, machine learning, geospatial analysis, or related analytical disciplines.

Proficiency in Python and/or R.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Proven ability to manage priorities, facilitate discussions, and drive outcomes independently.

Strong presentation, leadership, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.

Experience with Informatica Data Quality (IDQ) and/or Master Data Management (MDM) implementations.

Knowledge of Oracle, PL/SQL, Business Objects, Tableau, and other reporting tools.

Experience with Business Intelligence solutions and reporting frameworks.

Knowledge of ITIL, service management, and process management practices.

Familiarity with Stata, C++, MS Access, and Crystal Reports.

Experience implementing data governance, information security, and reporting solutions.

Knowledge of Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) implementations.

Experience with GIS tools such as QGIS or ArcGIS for spatial analysis.

Professional certifications such as IIBA, ITIL Foundation, or similar credentials are an advantage.




What We Look For

Strong business acumen combined with technical expertise.

Ability to influence stakeholders and drive consensus across teams.

Passion for solving complex data challenges and delivering high-quality solutions.

Strong attention to detail, accountability, and ownership from concept through delivery.

Data Scientist

We are building a top data science team focused on computer vision and are looking for exceptional people to work with us. Data labeling for images, videos, 3D point clouds and volumetric medical images (DICOM)
Data visualization and quality control
State-Of-The-Art Deep Learning models for segmentation, detection, classification and other tasks

Try Community Edition

Working with top github repositories with state-of-the-art models, train, test, deploy and integrate them into Supervisely

Experience in building client-server apps using FastApi, Flask, Uvicorn or others

Experience in building your own startup or product

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Ben jij gepassioneerd over het omzetten van data naar waardevolle inzichten? Wil je werken aan uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende enterprise-organisaties? Sluit je aan bij ons team als Data Scientist en help de toekomst van organisaties vorm te geven met innovatieve data-oplossingen die écht impact maken.

Voor verschillende enterprise-klanten ontwikkelen we geavanceerde datamodellen en algoritmes om waardevolle inzichten uit uiteenlopende datasets te halen. Daarbij maken we gebruik van moderne technologieën en cloudplatformen zoals Azure, maar we zijn platformonafhankelijk en gaan elke technische uitdaging graag aan.

Wat al onze projecten gemeen hebben, is dat data een cruciale rol speelt in de besluitvorming en dat de oplossingen daadwerkelijk in productie worden ingezet. Daarom staan datakwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en een soepele integratie centraal. Daarnaast monitoren we continu de prestaties van onze oplossingen, zodat eventuele problemen tijdig worden gesignaleerd en opgelost.

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende projecten in verschillende sectoren. Daardoor krijg je de kans om verschillende businessvraagstukken en databronnen te leren kennen en zowel je technische als domeinkennis verder uit te breiden.

Wat ga je doen?


Samenwerken met toonaangevende klanten uit verschillende sectoren en complexe businessvraagstukken oplossen.
Geavanceerde machine learning-modellen en datagedreven strategieën ontwikkelen die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming.
Samenwerken met multidisciplinaire teams om impactvolle oplossingen te realiseren en succesvol te integreren binnen de IT-omgeving van de klant.
Continu innoveren door nieuwe technieken en tools te verkennen en toe te passen, waarmee je zowel de projecten als je eigen ontwikkeling naar een hoger niveau tilt.


This is what we offer

Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, onder persoonlijke begeleiding van ervaren Data Scientists en Architecten. Via onze Itility Academy kun je trainingen volgen op zowel technisch als persoonlijk vlak. Daarnaast hebben we een actieve community waarin we tijdens Tech Hours kennis delen, nieuwe tools demonstreren en ervaringen uitwisselen.

26 vakantiedagen.

Leaseauto + tankpas of mobiliteitsvergoeding + kilometervergoeding.

Bonus op basis van jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en de gezamenlijke resultaten.
Laptop en telefoon.
Toegang tot de Itility Academy voor hard- en softskilltrainingen.
Gebruik van professionele sportschool bij Itility.
Hybride werken.

Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Data Scientist of in een vergelijkbare rol.
Ervaring met statistische modellering, predictive analytics en machine learning.
Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python.
Ervaring met R, Julia of vergelijkbare programmeertalen is een pré.

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d) Forecasting & Demand Planning
Description:
Jeden Abend wirft der Handel Ware weg, die niemand bestellt hat. Und gleichzeitig steht jemand vor einem leeren Regal. Beides sind Planungsfehler und beide lassen sich rechnen.




Genau das machen wir bei Circly: KI-gestützte Absatzprognosen für Handel, FMCG und Industrie. Unsere Kund:innen planen damit Bestellmengen, Produktion und Personal. Wenn dein Modell besser wird, landet weniger im Müll. Das ist kein Marketing-Satz, das ist die Metrik.




Wir sind ein Team mit Büro im 1. Bezirk. Kein Data-Team in einer Konzernabteilung, das Tickets abarbeitet. Du sprichst mit den Kund:innen, deren Daten du modellierst, und mit dem Founder-Team sitzt du im selben Raum.


Aufgaben


Du entwickelst und verbesserst unsere Forecasting-Modelle für Absatz- und Bedarfsprognosen.




Du bereitest Kund:innendaten auf: Datenanbindung, Bereinigung, Feature Engineering




Du analysierst Prognosegüte, findest Ursachen für Abweichungen und leitest daraus Modellverbesserungen ab




Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf, in Berichten und im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen




Du bringst deine Ideen ins Produkt ein und arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung und Founder-Team zusammen


Qualifikation


Das solltest du mitbringen





mindestens 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung als Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle


sicherer Umgang mit Python und den gängigen Bibliotheken (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn)


mindestens ein Datenprojekt, das du von der Rohdatei bis zum fertigen Ergebnis umgesetzt hast


Erfahrung in Datenvorverarbeitung und Data Engineering

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
At Hexa, we are looking for a Data Scientist ready to make a difference by crafting impactful data-driven solutions. This dynamic role offers the chance to work closely with diverse teams, developing analytical and machine learning models that create measurable business value.




What you will do

Analyze structured and unstructured data to identify patterns, opportunities and risks that support business decisions.
Design, build, validate and optimize supervised and unsupervised machine learning models.
Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model tuning and performance evaluation.
Support the model lifecycle through experimentation, versioning, documentation and deployment readiness.
Ensure analytical quality, reliability and responsible utilization of data and models.




What we are looking for

At least 3 years of experience as a Data Scientist.
Strong experience with Python (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn; with basics of PyTorch/TensorFlow).Experience with Terraform, Docker, and/or Python (plus).

Continuous learning and development opportunities, including support for training and certification throughout your journey.
Private health insurance from day one, with optional family extension subject to internal policy.
Confidential mental health support through Hexa’s well-being initiatives.
Flexibility whenever the role and context allow it, supporting sustainable balance across different life stages.
Family support measures, including childcare-related support subject to internal policy.
Community moments, shared milestones and a culture of trust, contribution and inclusion.
Exposure to different IT contexts, teams and business areas, helping you grow your understanding of the technology market.




Compensation transparency

Base salary range: EUR 22 000 – EUR 28 000 gross/year.

Total compensation: up to EUR 34 000/year.

The salary range is based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including required competencies, professional experience, level of responsibility and role requirements. Final compensation will be determined according to the candidate's profile and position requirements.




Equal opportunity

At Lutron, we are transforming how people experience light through intelligent, connected lighting devices and systems. As a Data Scientist, you will apply data science, analytics, machine learning, and AI to help improve customer experiences, products, and business operations. Partner with engineering and product teams to support deployment of models and analytics into production systems

Continuously learn and apply new data science and machine learning techniques relevant to Lutron’s products and business

Title: Product Data Scientist
Description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

Ever wonder how much of a lift a new flavor gives us, or which flavor a specific machine should be pouring in a specific office at a specific moment? That's this role. We're looking for a Product Data Scientist to support both our Beverage and Software product teams — measuring the incremental impact of every new flavor we launch, and building the recommendation engine that decides what each machine should offer next. You'll also own analytics across our Bevi-proprietary digital experiences, including the UI and the Well, plus our other websites (get a quote, order more, technical support). You'll partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering on both teams, turning data into a clear point of view on what we build next. We're looking for someone who spots what needs to get built before being asked, and drives it to done rather than waiting for direction.

Your Day To Day


Own analytics for our Bevi-proprietary digital experiences, including the UI and the Well — consult with Software on tracking structure, and own the analysis that shows what's working and what's not to inform the product roadmap.
Own tracking and analytics for Bevi.co and Partner.co, including GA4 and tag management, to inform the product roadmap.
Recommend the right analytics tools for our web properties alongside GA4/GTM — session replay, self-serve data, testing, heatmaps — in partnership with Product.
Measure the incremental impact of new flavors, blending A/B testing with non-traditional methods where clean experiments aren't possible.
Build the flavor recommendation engine — models that identify the optimal flavor profile per machine (or cluster), within real constraints like weekly-max updates and required static options.
Translate data and analytics into clear insights and recommendations.
Build clear, informative dashboards and drive adoption to democratize product data.
Partner with data engineering and software teams on data quality, tagging, and instrumentation.


Who You Are


2-4 years of professional experience in product analytics, digital analytics, or data science.
Strong hands-on experience with GA4 and tag management (e.g., GTM) — comfortable owning both the tracking implementation and the analysis built on top of it.
Hands-on experience designing and analyzing experiments — A/B testing and non-traditional/quasi-experimental methods (e.g., pre/post, difference-in-differences, propensity score matching) for situations where clean randomization isn't possible.
Strong SQL and Python/R for querying, modeling, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, PowerBI, Hex).
You use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster (eg exploratory analysis, code, documentation), and think about how to make product data accessible to AI tools as well as people.
A proactive, go-getter mindset — you notice what needs to get built before you're asked, and drive your own work to completion without needing to be chased.
Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.


At Bevi, We Believe Compensation Is a Powerful Tool To Attract, Retain, And Grow Talent. Our Compensation Philosophy Centers On 5 Principles


Market-driven - We anchor pay decisions in real-time market data
Performance-based - We reward individual impact, not just tenure
Equitable - We ensure fairness across teams, roles, and demographics
Growth-focused - We invest in talent that scales with Bevi
Total Rewards approach - We strategically balance base pay, bonuses, benefits, and equity


The posted compensation range reflects the salary* for this position. Some roles may be eligible for a commission plan or a bonus incentive. All Bevi employees receive equity in the form of stock options. All full-time employees are invited to participate in our Total Rewards plan, which includes health & medical benefits, flexible spending accounts, flexible PTO, and more. Offers to join Bevi are based on a few criteria, including the scope of the role, the candidate's work experience, targeted skills, internal equity of the team, and external market data.


For Sales roles: The posted range reflects base salary plus commission which is the total potential on target earnings (OTE) for the position.


Pay Range

$120,700—$149,100 USD

Benefits


Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans with BlueCross BlueShield, 95% paid by employer
401(k) with company match
Flexible PTO plus 12 company holidays, and additional paid days for sick leave, etc
Generous fully paid parental leave for both birth parents and non-birth parents
Fully employer paid disability and life insurances
Wellness and fitness reimbursements
Monthly stipends for cell phone use and commuting costs
Onsite snacks, weekly catered lunch, and (of course) unlimited Bevi ... plus composting and terra-cycling, too
Happy hours, team-building events, bagel breakfasts, Values awards - and more.


A note on AI in our hiring process: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and interviews may be recorded to support note-taking, just let us know if you'd prefer we don't. We'll also ask how you're learning and experimenting with AI in your work. Growing our AI fluency is something every Bevi team member is committed to and invested in.

Our commitment to responsible innovation is reflected in our partnership with the Mass AI Coalition, a collaboration that aligns with our dedication to community-driven progress and the future of technology.

We're passionate about supporting career growth and would love to be part of your professional journey. We also know that talent comes in many forms. We value individual accomplishments, specialized knowledge, and genuine passion over simply checking boxes on a requirements list. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we're looking for people who are ready to build what's next. If any of our open positions interest you, we'd encourage you to apply! A member of the Bevi Talent team 'recruiting@bevi.co' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.

Accommodations

Bevi is committed to an inclusive hiring process and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact recruiting@bevi.co.
